criteria.authority: Separate exact grants, truthful capabilities, denied writes do not mutate
criteria.installed_execution: Distributed wheel/starter paired execution and separate quality decision
criteria.diagnostics: Secret-safe distinct local/access/descriptor/missing-resource diagnostics without execution
criteria.uncertainty: Uncertain owned execution refuses replay and allows explicit interruption after local exit
criteria.rotation_recovery: Saved report survives same-principal overlap/revoke restarts at fixed journal root without callbacks
criteria.reader_delivery: Reader sees minimal unknown/coherent latest activity while admin stays denied

diagnostics.limitation: Missing request is capabilities.unsupported; bundle-only doctor does not establish bundle existence

uncertainty.liveness: Unknown remotely; owned synchronous app process had exited; no provider job was launched

reader_delivery.fixtureAging: Owned PostgreSQL receive timestamps advanced explicitly; no real elapsed-wait claim
reader_delivery.semantics: Application observation only; delayed event time is visible; no consumption or evaluator liveness claim

limits: No provider/model execution or provider termination test
No network filesystem or distributed locking
Existing service binary to source build is not attested
remainingFriction: Static grant changes require two coordinated restarts; write right is broader than evaluation
No remote evaluator heartbeat/progress; local uncertainty remains an operator responsibility
Missing request preflight is labeled capabilities.unsupported and suggests retry_same_command; bundle-only doctor accepts a nonexistent UUID
